subject: Re: HQ day-of operations / visitor clearance & NDA checklist
messages:
From: Harrison Garcia <harrison.garcia@horizonmed.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-21T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: HQ visit — finalizing arrival time and NDA

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for hosting our team next Wednesday. Quick logistics question: we have a couple of late flights coming in and one attendee (Sara Patel) will likely arrive ~90 minutes after the original 10:00am start.

Two asks:
- Can we shift the start to 11:00am so the core stakeholders are present for the product walkthrough?
- I tried the DocuSign link and it looks like the NDA hasn't been routed correctly — can your side trigger a new signing request or confirm we should scan the signed PDF back to you?

Also, are there any special badging steps for contractors (Sara is a contractor listed under HorizonMed) and do we need to share passport/ID info ahead of time?

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can lock travel.

Best,
Harrison
Head of Integrations, HorizonMed

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Harrison Garcia <harrison.garcia@horizonmed.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-21T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: HQ visit — finalizing arrival time and NDA

Hi Harrison — thanks for the heads up. Yes, we can move the main walkthrough to 11:00am. That gives us time to do an 11:45am deep-dive on the integration patterns after the initial demo.

On the NDA: our legal team re-routed the DocuSign envelope this morning — you should get a fresh DocuSign link in the next 30 minutes. If anyone prefers to scan & upload, we're fine with a signed PDF attached to a reply, but DocuSign helps keep an audit trail.

Badging: contractors are fine but SecurePass (our visitor badging vendor) needs full name, date of birth, and a government ID number (driver's license or passport). If you can share that info for Sara and any contractors, laura will upload it to the badge queue. We mark contractor badges as "escort required" so they must be accompanied by one of our hosts while on site.

I've looped in Laura for badge upload + Monica (CS ops) for the day-of runner. Ben — can you confirm room/AV availability if we start 11:00 and run to ~3:00pm (with lunch at 12:30)?

I'll send a short run-of-show once we confirm.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Customer Engagement
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-21T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: HQ visit — finalizing arrival time and NDA

Marissa / Laura / Monica —

Confirmed: Conference Room "Maple 3" is available 10:30–15:30 and AV team can flip from demo rig to integration deep-dive at 11:45. We'll be ready for an 11:00 start if you want to use the additional 30 minutes to settle.

Notes / action items:
- AV: HDMI + USB-C feed + local laptop fallback; Ben will bring a spare Thunderbolt dongle.
- Network: guest VLAN provisioning requires device MACs if they want wired access; otherwise Wi-Fi certs work but we recommend staging all demo laptops on our isolated demo network.
- Catering: lunch options (boxed salads / protein + veg / GF/vegetarian). Monica please confirm final headcount by Monday 11/27 5pm PT.
- Badging: Laura to submit contractor details to SecurePass by EOD today for same-day badge printing.

Attachments: day-of-ops-pack.pdf (internal checklist / badge templates / shuttle pass map)

Ben Carter
Venue Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Harrison Garcia <harrison.garcia@horizonmed.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, SecurePass <pass@securepass.io>
Date: 2027-11-21T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: HQ visit — finalizing arrival time and NDA

Marissa — thanks, all.

Per DocuSign: I signed the NDA and attached a copy for your records (HorizonMed_NDA_signed.pdf). I also re-routed through DocuSign — should show as completed on your side.

We will send Sara's ID (passport number + DOB) to Laura via the secure SecurePass upload link (copying pass@securepass.io). Can you confirm who from Redwood will be the escort for contractors? Ben or Monica?

Headcount: 8 total (4 HorizonMed employees, 3 contractors incl. Sara, 1 external consultant). Dietary notes: 2 vegetarian, 1 gluten-free.

Final ask: Can you send a short parking note for attendees — nearest visitor lot and overflow instructions? If there's a pickup spot for a shuttle at 10:40, that would help the later arrivals.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Harrison
